reason: Three-time Grand Slam champion and former world No. 3 who is ending his career at Swiss Indoors Basel (24 Oct to 1 Nov 2026). Official tournament and ATP sources confirm the farewell. The reported Basel walk-out and standing ovation could not be confirmed in any source opened, so it is left out.
